BSNL JTO Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) has released answer key for the post of Junior Telecom Officer JTO (Telecom). A total of 100 posts have been announced under this recruitment. The online correction form process for BSNL Junior Telecom Officer JTO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 June 2026, to 03 July 2026. The examination was held on 23 August 2026 Candidates must download their BSNL Junior Telecom Officer JTO Answer Key 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 04 June 2026
  • Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 04-11 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 23 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 12 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 29 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
